 Moderate to heavy thundery showers expected over most of the island Moderate to heavy thundery showers expected over most of Singapore on Nov 16 afternoon. PHOTO: AsiaOne/Danial Zahrin PUBLISHED ON November 16, 2026 4:38 PM UPDATED November 16, 2026 5:15 PM BY Sean Ler Heavy rain is expected over many areas of Singapore on Monday (Nov 16) afternoon.
 In a heavy rain warning issued at 4.04pm, the Meteorological Service Singapore (MSS) said that moderate to heavy thundery showers are expected between 4.30pm and 5.30pm.
 Checks by AsiaOne on the agency's weather radar showed moderate to heavy rain clouds across the eastern, central and western regions.
 National water agency PUB has issued alerts on the risk of flash floods for the following areas:
 Lorong Gambir, from Lorong Penchalak to Gambir Walk, till 5.26pm
 Puay Hee Avenue, till 5.39pm
 Wan Tho Avenue, till 5.42pm
 Happy Avenue North, till 5.44pm
 Riverside Road, till 6pm
 Junction of Senoko Road and Admiralty Road West, till 6.10pm
 Singapore is currently experiencing the onset of the inter-monsoon period.
 During this period, winds will shift to become light and variable, while moderate to heavy thundery showers are expected over parts of the island on most days, MSS said in its fortnightly weather outlook issued on Oct 29 .
 It also stated that showers could extend into the evening on a few days.
 MSS is expected to issue a new fortnightly weather outlook later on Monday.
